topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening administrative and conceptual framing for the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Cellular and developmental origins of cancer and in vitro study
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic aberrations disrupt multicellular differentiation and tissue architecture to initiate cancer, alongside the experimental limitations of studying these processes in cell culture.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and pathological distinction of benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics contrast the physical and histological characteristics of localized benign tumors with invasive and metastasizing malignant neoplasms.

topics.label: Stepwise neoplastic progression and clinical impacts of benign tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate the sequential evolution of tissue from benign precursor lesions to invasive adenocarcinoma and evaluate the clinical hazards posed by non-malignant growths.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and mechanisms of clinical morbidity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the standard naming conventions for classifying tumors and explain the physical and systemic mechanisms by which tumor growth causes clinical illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across human populations and multicellular species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine patterns of tumor frequency across human demographics and explore comparative cancer incidence across animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening methodologies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and compare the diagnostic effectiveness and challenges of screening programs for different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Conclusion and administrative closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by referencing the learning outcomes and providing administrative information regarding upcoming practicals and lectures.
